We are proud to announce that we are starting to accept requests from people to join our Abunka playtest event.

ABUNKA is a pc MOBA inspired 3 vs 3 strategic action brawler with a distinguished shooting and building mechanics Armed with special weapons and abilities, the warriors start their training for the epic battles ahead, all together to save the life on “ and bring back peace

You can request to join on this  link: 

Abunka Playtest

We will announce the server opening times and dates during this month. stay connected!

We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!
